name: TMDb Evidence Quality and Identity Verification

methodology.identifier_unit: One DBpedia entity / IMDb identifier pair; all TMDb candidate rows retained
methodology.no_result_handling: Explicit placeholder row retained for every identifier pair without returned TMDb candidates
methodology.title_comparison: Unicode NFKC and case-folded normalized exact equality after removal of parenthetical/bracketed qualifiers
methodology.year_comparison: Available English DBpedia labels, DBpedia release dates, DBpedia URI year, and TMDb release year
methodology.media_type_assessment: Explicit TMDb media-type evaluation; non-movie records flagged for review
methodology.imdb_role: Supporting title/year evidence from prior official IMDb cross-validation
methodology.movielens_role: Supporting identifier corroboration when TMDb IDs are shared

limitations: Title and year agreement are corroborating evidence, not absolute proof of identity.
DBpedia metadata may be incomplete or contain aliases for related works.
TMDb search results may contain unrelated candidates or multiple media types.
IMDb-derived TMDb lookups are not fully independent identifier chains.
MovieLens identifier agreement is supporting evidence and does not independently prove identity.
No automatic identity verification or entity merging was performed.
